{{Top|leg}}
The '''E-45 interdictor sentry''' was an [[Interdictor/Legends|interdictor]] [[Drone/Legends|drone]] produced by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]] that could be carried as a payload by [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]. The E-45 generated an [[Interdiction field/Legends|interdiction field]], and was armed with a standard [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] for defense.
